title: Thatcham Festival kicks off with Fest Off
summary: The Thatcham Festival kicks off with a street show 'Fest Off' on Saturday evening.
imageAlt: Mirror Couple street entertainers (l) and a performer on stage (r)
caption: Mirror Couple street entertainers (l) and a performer on stage (r)

content.text:
Thatcham Festival got off to a great start over the weekend with the highlight being Fest Off where the High Street was taken over by a stage where acts performed as well as various stalls along the street. Dozens of people flocked to the High Street to see the performances on stage and to sample what the stalls had to offer.

Thatcham Festival runs from the 9th to the 18th October for 10 days of events, activities and experiences celebrating the creativity, talent and community spirit of Thatcham. With many events free to attend and no event costing more than £7, the Festival offers something for everyone, whatever your age or interests.

Form more information, vists the Thatcham Town Council website https://thatchamtowncouncil.gov.uk/event/thatcham-festival-2/
